row.body: The storage key is clipped to an inventory that lists the load as too large to secure; a second hand has marked the location cleared.
row.title: Too large to secure

sidecar.gloss: A load marked unsecured is also marked cleared.
sidecar.rival_reading: A program crew could have left bulky tools at a site; the conflicting status does not show who cleared it.

row.body: matching white stripes cross the candle and clipboard. a name-sized patch on the candle has been scrubbed bare.
row.title: missing count beside the candle

sidecar.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.

row.body: Photograph back: the cross marks the store used by the crop trial. One sample crate was removed before the inventory and left a blue outline on the floor.
row.title: Cross beside the trial store

sidecar.rival_reading: A disaster-response worker could have made the same observation; this personal paper does not identify who directed the work.

row.body: Torn page: there should be sampling jars and boot covers here. The crop crew left them when two workers developed rashes and the planned collection was cancelled.

row.body: Personal farm log: “too big to secure” was the old packing floor. The trial team used only one bay, yet fresh powder reached the locked bays overnight.
